focus: Separate reproduced defects from observations, hypotheses, recommendations, and untested authenticated journeys.
Require exact target, environment, steps, observed result, expected result, and retained evidence for confirmed findings.
Attack one-root-cause claims with bounded counterfactuals and preserve unresolved alternative explanations.
Keep passive testing, authenticated testing, disclosure, external submission, and remediation authority separate.
Fail closed when capture artifacts, platform lanes, timestamps, or exact-head bindings are missing or stale.
